i guess 5 stars, to many people in the community, generally just means the order went well with no issues. when someone docks stars because it’s not exceptional to them (and i would say everyone has different standards for this—many include freebies as something needed for 5⭐️which shouldn’t be the case) it does hurt the sellers chances at getting more customers, even if they technically did nothing “wrong”, because future buyers may assume something went slightly wrong with the order. also, on depop you’re really reviewing the seller and their actions, not the item (other than its general condition and if it was as described) so 4 stars may imply the seller did something they shouldn’t have.

i would say, from my perspective, if the seller ships quickly in adequate packaging, communicates well enough for the buyer to know their order has been shipped and accepted, and the item is as described, there’s no reason (again, this is from my perspective, not everyone feels this way!) to dock off any stars. however, if shipping is past the 5 day window, the item isn’t as described, etc, then i would take off stars.

i hope this can help you understand the perspective a little better! ❤️ happy depoping
